# Coding AI Prompt — Build a Fictional Landing Page in the Codex.io Visual Style

You are building a complete, production-quality landing page for a **fictional** brand/product. Do not use the real brand name "Codex.io", its logo, trademarks, or product names. Invent a fictional brand name, product name, and all user-facing copy in English. Reuse only the visual style described below.

## 1. Project Deliverables
- Create exactly three separate files: `index.html`, `style.css`, and `script.js`.
- Use semantic HTML5 elements.
- Keep all styling in `style.css`; do not use inline `style="..."` attributes.
- Use one consistent class-naming convention (BEM recommended) across all markup and CSS.
- Do not use placeholder-only copy where real copy is expected; invent realistic English copy for every section.
- Include a single deferred `<script src="script.js" defer></script>` reference in `index.html`.

## 2. CSS-First Architecture & Theme Tokens
- Store all visual tokens in `:root` and theme classes using CSS variables.
- Required color tokens:
  - `--color-citrine-signal: #e5ff5d;`
  - `--color-carbon-black: #111111;`
  - `--color-bone-white: #f9f9f9;`
  - `--color-graphite: #2b2b2b;`
  - `--color-ash: #6e6e6e;`
  - `--color-stone: #9c9c9c;`
  - `--color-smoke: #565656;`
  - `--color-chalk: #d6d6d6;`
  - `--color-cream-paper: #eeeeee;`
  - `--color-pure-black: #000000;`
  - `--color-sand: #b7b3a2;`
- Required semantic tokens:
  - `--primary`, `--secondary`, `--bg-primary`, `--bg-secondary`, `--text-primary`, `--text-secondary`, `--text-success`, `--text-error`, `--border-default`, `--border-error`, `--border-success`
- Required shape/spacing tokens:
  - `--radius-sm: 4px;`
  - `--radius-md: 8px;`
  - `--radius-lg: 12px;`
  - `--radius-pill: 9999px;`
  - `--shadow-sm`, `--shadow-md`
  - `--spacing-gap`
  - `--transition-fast`, `--transition-normal`, `--ease-standard`
  - `--z-dropdown`, `--z-modal`, `--z-toast`
- Enforce contrast pairing in both light and dark themes: light backgrounds pair with dark text; dark backgrounds pair with light text.
- Do not default light backgrounds to pure white; use `#fefefe` only where a near-white is needed. The cream reversal must use `#eeeeee`.
- Use Google Fonts for typography. Load Neue Haas Grotesk if available via Google Fonts; otherwise use the documented substitute stack (`Inter, Söhne, Neue Haas Grotesk Display, system-ui, sans-serif`) and bind it to `--font-base`.
- Use Google Material Symbols/Icons only. Do not use raw inline SVGs or local icon files.

## 3. Mandatory Dark Mode
- Implement dark mode under both `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and a `.dark` class selector.
- Switch background and text variables seamlessly without changing HTML structure.
- Persist the user’s theme choice in `localStorage`, falling back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit.
- Provide a visible theme toggle with correct `aria-pressed` and `aria-label` state.
- Ensure sufficient contrast in both themes.

## 4. Layout & Responsive Rules
- Use Flexbox for layout structures.
- Every flex container must default to `align-items: center` unless there is an explicitly justified exception.
- Build mobile-first, responsive layouts that convert rows to columns on small viewports.
- Prevent horizontal scrolling.
- Max page width: `1280px`, centered.
- Section vertical padding: `80px`.
- Card padding: `24px` to `32px`.
- Element gap: `16px` to `24px`.
- Use a vertical stack of full-width bands. Rhythm: dark hero → dark logo cloud → dark feature → light reversal → dark continues.

## 5. Visual Style Specification
- Theme mood: dark, quiet, high-contrast, with one electric lime accent (`#e5ff5d`) doing all chromatic work.
- Primary canvas: `#111111`.
- Elevated surfaces: `#2b2b2b`.
- Muted surfaces: `#6e6e6e`.
- Primary text on dark: `#f9f9f9`.
- Muted text: `#9c9c9c`.
- Borders on dark: `#d6d6d6` for cards, `#9c9c9c` for hairlines, `#565656` for subtle dividers.
- Cream reversal background: `#eeeeee`.
- Text on cream: `#111111` for headlines, `#9c9c9c` for muted copy.
- Use exactly one chromatic accent: `#e5ff5d`. Do not introduce blue, red, purple, or additional lime shades.
- Typography:
  - Sole typeface: Neue Haas Grotesk Text or approved substitute.
  - Weights: 400 for body/nav/UI, 500 for emphasized labels and button text.
  - Display headline: 80px, line-height 0.90, letter-spacing -0.01em, uppercase, weight 400.
  - Section heading: 24px, line-height 1.20, weight 500.
  - Body: 16px, line-height 1.50.
  - Small labels: 10–12px, uppercase, letter-spacing +0.027em to +0.032em, weight 500.
  - OpenType features: `"kern" on, "liga" on`.
- Border radius:
  - Interactive elements: 4px.
  - Nav container: 8px.
  - Cards: 12px.
  - Decorative elements: 20px.
  - Do not use pill-shaped buttons except where explicitly specified as pills.
- Elevation:
  - No shadows on nav, buttons, or cards.
  - Cards rely on color step from canvas to surface.
  - Citrine cube uses inner gradient highlights and outer glow `rgba(229,255,93,0.15) 0 0 40px`.
- Imagery:
  - No photography, lifestyle imagery, or human faces.
  - Use abstract iconographic visuals only: citrine cube, blockchain node icons, thin dashed connector lines.
  - All imagery is monochrome white or lime.
  - The citrine cube must never be rendered as a flat 2D square; use CSS transforms/gradients to suggest a 3D translucent isometric block.

## 6. Component Requirements
### 6.1 Buttons
- Citrine Primary Button: `#e5ff5d` background, `#111111` text, 4px radius, padding `12px 24px`, Neue Haas 500 at 16px, small left-side Google Material icon.
- Dark Primary Button: `#111111` background, `#f9f9f9` text, 4px radius, padding `12px 24px`, small left-side Google Material icon.
- Ghost Button: transparent background, 1px border (`#f9f9f9` on dark, `#111111` on light), uppercase Neue Haas 500 at 12px, +0.032em tracking, 4px radius, padding `10px 20px`.
- All buttons must implement: default, hover, focus, active/pressed, loading, disabled, success, and error states via CSS classes.
- Minimum touch target: 44x44px.
- Loading state must disable interactions, prevent double-clicks, and show a CSS spinner or animated Google icon without changing button dimensions.

### 6.2 Navigation Bar
- Transparent on dark canvas.
- Left: fictional wordmark in `#f9f9f9`, weight 500, 20px, tracking 0.027em.
- Center-right: nav links in Neue Haas 500 at 12px, +0.027em tracking, `#f9f9f9`, separated by 32px.
- Right: Citrine Primary Button.
- Nav container radius: 8px.
- No background fill.

### 6.3 Cards
- Flexible Flexbox layout.
- Styled with subtle borders and elevation using `--bg-secondary` and CSS variables.
- Hover: elevation/shadow shift or subtle transform (`translateY(-2px)`).
- Focus-within: highlight card borders when a child link/button receives focus.
- Loading skeleton: shimmer animation defined in CSS.
- Empty state: structured fallback with Google Icon and guidance text.

### 6.4 Forms & Inputs
- Account for empty, focused, filled, valid, invalid, disabled, and read-only states.
- Structure: flex container wrapping label, input field, and dedicated error feedback container.
- Use `aria-live` regions for dynamic feedback.

### 6.5 Modal / Popup
- Account for opening, open, loading, success/error, and closing states with CSS transitions.
- Centered flex container with backdrop overlay.
- Google Icon close button.
- Keyboard focus trapping.
- Close via `Esc` or overlay click.

### 6.6 Additional Components
- Citrine Cube: translucent lime 3D isometric block with internal gradient highlights and outer glow. Appears in hero, constellation diagram, and cream reversal cluster.
- Constellation Network Diagram: central citrine cube with 12–16 node circles in a radial ring, connected by thin dashed `#565656` lines.
- Node Icon Ring: 40px circle, 1px border, centered 20px icon in lime or white.
- Display Headline: 80px, weight 400, line-height 0.90, uppercase.
- Section Heading: 24px, weight 500, line-height 1.20.
- Body Text: 16px, line-height 1.50, max reading width 560px.
- Feature Pill: uppercase 10–12px, +0.032em tracking, `#e5ff5d` text, optional 4px radius background.
- Logo Cloud Row: two centered rows of monochrome white logos at 60% opacity, 48px column gap, no card backgrounds.
- Split Feature Block: 40% text / 60% visual, 80px gap, vertically centered.
- Reversal Band: full-width `#eeeeee` background, large cube clusters at far left/right, centered content stack, 80px top/bottom padding.

## 7. Required Landing Page Sections
Build the page in this order:
1. **Hero**: centered headline-over-cube composition, cube above headline, scattered node icons orbiting the cube, primary CTA, secondary ghost CTA.
2. **Logo Cloud**: two centered rows of fictional customer logos.
3. **Features**: 3 cards describing fictional product capabilities.
4. **How It Works**: 3 steps with icons and concise copy.
5. **Testimonials**: customer quotes with names/roles.
6. **Pricing**: 3 tiers with feature lists and CTA buttons.
7. **FAQ**: accessible accordion or disclosure pattern.
8. **Final CTA**: strong closing headline and primary action.
9. **Footer**: secondary links, legal links, and theme toggle.

## 8. UX & Micro-Interaction Rules
- Responsive by default.
- Smooth CSS transitions on all state changes using `var(--transition-normal)`.
- Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Accessibility:
  - Sufficient contrast in both themes.
  - Never rely solely on color to communicate state.
  - Semantic HTML5 elements.
  - Correct ARIA roles/labels on custom widgets.
  - Logical DOM/focus order.
  - Full keyboard operability.
  - `aria-live` regions for dynamic feedback.
- Every click, hover, or submission must trigger a visible state change.
- Destructive actions must be visually distinct in both themes.

## 9. JavaScript Rules
- Implement theme toggle persistence and any purely presentational interactions (FAQ accordion, modal open/close, loading button states).
- Do not write JavaScript for form validation, popups/modals business logic, or utility/helper functions unless explicitly requested; if such logic is needed, ask the user how they want it handled instead of generating it.
- Do not introduce new HTML elements from JavaScript beyond what is already in the markup.

## 10. Final Constraints
- No inline CSS.
- No photography.
- No second chromatic accent.
- No pill-shaped buttons except where explicitly specified.
- No rounded card backgrounds with shadows.
- No more than one cream reversal band per page.
- Every screen must include at least one citrine cube presence, cube geometry reference, or constellation pattern implying a cube at center.
- If a requested style change cannot be achieved without adding markup, stop and ask the user what they want instead of silently inserting new HTML.
